record.question: Legally speaking, any offer, threat or attempt to apply criminal force to the body of another in a hostile manner is called :
record.explanation: Answer C: Assault. An offer, threat, or attempt to apply criminal force in a hostile manner is assault; hurt requires bodily pain, disease, or infirmity. Source/context note: Exam wording tracks the former IPC section 351; current Indian criminal law was recodified in 2024. Reference: https://www.indiacode.nic.in/handle/123456789/2263?view_type=browse. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
